passages.provision_quote: 9. Subject to subsection F of this section, for taxable years beginning from and after December 31 of the year in which notice is provided to the department pursuant to section 43-243, subsection B, paragraph 2, the tax is 2.5% of taxable income.
passages.note: SB 1828 phases the individual income tax to a 2.5% flat rate but also amends dozens of unrelated provisions (property tax formulas, UI wage base, sales tax exemptions, tax credits), making it an omnibus.
Marsh voted No on SB 1828's Senate Third Reading (16-14); a No vote on a multi-subject bill does not show which provision she opposed.

rows.reasoning: Marsh voted No on SB 1828 (2021), an omnibus taxation bill combining the individual income tax rate restructuring (eventually a 2.5% flat rate, matching rung 4's 'cut taxes broadly, including the main rates most people pay') with many unrelated provisions (property tax formulas, unemployment insurance wage base, sales tax exemptions, tax credits). Per V4.1, a No vote on a multi-subject bill proves nothing about the policy she objected to, and no statement ties her vote to the tax-rate clause specifically.
